method.score: total = 4*severity + 2*confidence + 2*blast_radius + 1*simplicity. severity = highest severity in the unit (critical=4 high=3 medium=2 low=1 info=0). confidence = lowest confidence in the unit (high=3 medium=2 low=1), so the score stays conservative. blast_radius = in-scope files the fix touches, capped at 5. simplicity: trivial=3 localized=2 non-trivial=1.
method.tie_break: severity desc, then primary_file (file of the lowest finding ID in the unit) ascending by byte order, then lowest finding ID.
method.auto_fix_rule: Eligible only if max severity <= high, min confidence >= medium, fix_unit is single-file or pattern-cluster, no cross-file-mismatch or doc-drift finding, no sensitive path from scope.json.sensitive_paths (commands.rs, capabilities/**, tauri.conf.json, crates/platform/src/windows/**, crates/ochistka-core/src/scan.rs), and (caller rule) no info-severity finding in the unit.
method.dedupe_rule: No finding has an anchor field, so duplicates were judged on content: a finding merges into another when it describes the same defect in the same test surface and one is a strict subset of the other. The survivor is the higher severity (then broader) finding. Merged findings stay in the survivor's unit and are set to triaged; no finding fields other than status were changed.
method.clustering_rule: Findings sharing one fix sit in one unit even across files (cascade or cross-cutting). Info findings were kept with low/medium findings when they share the fix, which makes that unit human-review. This is the reason for the low auto-fix count.

schema_warnings.summary: All 209 findings use a compact pre-v1.1 schema: id, file, lines, severity, confidence, type, summary, evidence, failure_scenario, status. Missing v1.1 fields in every file: line, end_line, anchor, title, description, impact, snippet, trace, linked_fix_id, related_findings, detected_by, fix_implementer_dissent. Semantic content is present (lines -> line/end_line, summary -> title/description, evidence -> snippet/trace, failure_scenario -> impact), so all are tolerated and included in the plan. No anchor means dedupe was done by content, not by anchor match.
schema_warnings.out_of_scope_note: These three name files under docs/, which scope.json lists as out of scope. Each is a drift between in-scope code and the doc, so they are planned (docs-reconciler, human review) and not marked malformed.

duplicates.reason: Both say contrastRatio is pinned only at the black/white 21:1 endpoints, so a wrong luminance exponent or channel weight and mid-tone AA failures pass. FND-0087 (info, filed on tokens.ts) is a subset of FND-0204 (low, tokens.test.ts).
Same file (api.test.ts). FND-0196 calls itself 'an instance of FND-0191': the Finding DTO shape is never checked against Rust output.

FND-0078 already lists the missing 1023/1024 and 1048575 boundary, the ТБ cap and .5 rounding cases. FND-0198 (boundary and cap not pinned, МБ/ТБ never asserted) and FND-0197 (12.4 cannot tell round from trunc) are the same format test gap seen from format.test.ts.

cross_cutting_themes.theme: TypeScript 6 vs 7 peer split and Node baseline
cross_cutting_themes.note: svelte-check pulls an undeclared TypeScript 6.0.3 while typescript ^7.0.2 is declared. @types/node ^26 vs the README's 'Node 22+' and the missing engines field. One decision (D4) fixes all of them.

Split by test file so each unit has one owner file. Shared pattern: a fixed-count microtask flush (FND-0175 Home.test, FND-0185 VirusesPage.test) and sync fake timers. Fix both the same way (waitFor/findBy, advanceTimersByTimeAsync). U12 and U13 should agree on that helper.
CLAUDE.md says VPN opens first (Разделы list) and also calls Вирусы the first in navigation (Антивирус section). The code opens VPN. Owner decision D1.

cross_cutting_themes.theme: Empty Программы, Диски, Оформление subsections and placeholder semantics
cross_cutting_themes.note: CLAUDE.md says these subsections are still to be defined (уточняются). Three sections ship with an empty lead. The placeholder text does not give a reason or the status terms. Owner decision D3 before code.

cross_cutting_themes.theme: Flat-colour contrast vs decorative background pattern
cross_cutting_themes.note: The data: SVG pattern is blocked by CSP in release, so it shows only in dev. Where it does show, placeholder, lead and footer text drop to about 4.27:1. Owner decision D2: keep the pattern (allow img-src data: and fix contrast) or drop it for flat colour.

cross_cutting_themes.theme: Scan pipeline (clamscan exit codes, parsing, target validation, concurrency)
cross_cutting_themes.note: All touch sensitive paths (scan.rs, commands.rs, windows/**). Do U02 (parser and exit codes) before U30 and U36, which also edit scan.rs, so the parser contract is stable.

plan.rationale: ADR 0001 says api.test.ts keeps the TS types honest against the Rust DTOs. It does not: no Rust serde output is read, so renaming a Rust field breaks the UI with every test green. invoke<T> is only a compile-time cast (FND-0060) and u64 values become JS number (FND-0091). The fix is a mechanism choice: generated TS types (ts-rs or specta) or Rust-emitted JSON fixtures checked by vitest. It touches both stacks, and every later DTO change depends on it. Ranked first by score (blast radius 5); in practice U02 is the only high-severity defect and can run in parallel. Needs decision D5.

Only high-severity defect. Exit code 2 from clamscan throws away every parsed FOUND line (FND-0005), so an infected file can go unreported on any scan that also hits a locked file. Order within the unit: (1) clamav.rs keeps the parsed report on exit 2 and puts the exit code in the error (FND-0048); (2) the scan.rs parser stops dropping malformed FOUND lines, reads 'Total errors' (FND-0009), rejects names containing newlines (FND-0006) and caps output size (FND-0055); (3) VirusesPage shows report.errors and reconciles infectedFiles with findings (FND-0100); (4) tests for the exit-code branches with a fake engine that cleans up its temp dir (FND-0050). FND-0005 is UNVERIFIED for real clamscan exit-2 behaviour. Confirm on Windows before closing. The deferred FND-0047 (stdout encoding) touches the same decoder.

Subsection ids are plain strings, and each page matches hand-typed literals. A rename in sections.ts silently removes a page. Fix: a literal union or const-derived type per section, used by every page's subsection prop, so svelte-check catches drift. This is a type contract change in sections.ts that forces caller updates (cascade), so it needs human review under the rules, but the change is mechanical. Do it before U07 and U15 because they add or rename subsections.

CLAUDE.md requires Windows code behind cfg with Unsupported stubs for other OSes. Today the windows modules compile and run everywhere (FND-0003, FND-0043), other unix targets report as Linux (FND-0072), the Unsupported text is grammatically wrong for many features (FND-0012) and is a duplicated literal (FND-0071), and the tests are not cfg-gated, so a Linux green says nothing about Windows (FND-0013, FND-0014). This is architectural, and CLAUDE.md says humans decide architecture (decision D6).

Scan lifecycle. The backend has no single-scan guard, cancellation or timeout (FND-0026). The UI destroys VirusesPage state on section switch and can start a second scan (FND-0018). assess_file is a sync command doing filesystem I/O (FND-0025), and the UI stays in 'scanning' during the follow-up assessFile calls (FND-0098). Order: backend guard, cancel and async assess_file first, then lift scan state out of the page (store or keep-alive), then the scanning-state fix. Timeout and cancel policy is decision D18.

Keyboard focus is invisible in the right rail: the focus ring is #080808 on a #080808 background (WCAG 2.4.7), and the comment claiming matching contrast is wrong. Use a ring colour from the tokens that reaches 3:1 on the rail, and fix the comment. Trivial, one file, medium severity, high confidence: the best auto-fix candidate. The neutral contrast tests that would catch this again are in U18 (FND-0206).

Программы, Диски and Оформление ship with empty leads and no defined subsections. The lead test only checks typeof string, so it passes on empty (FND-0200). Section ids and titles are never checked together (FND-0202), and the Процессы subsections are not pinned (FND-0201). Placeholders use one generic 'В разработке' with no reason or CLAUDE.md status term (FND-0123), and Computer's Настройки/Boost/Драйверы do not follow the documented Drivers layout or the disabled-with-reason rule (FND-0130). The content is an owner decision (D3); the code and tests follow from it.

System overview locking. A panic while the System mutex is held poisons it permanently (FND-0037). Disk enumeration with refresh-everything runs under that lock, so one hung removable drive blocks every call (FND-0039). On the UI side a call that never settles leaves Home pending forever (FND-0102), and remounts pile up blocked threads (FND-0103). Order: recover from poisoning and narrow the lock in mod.rs, then a client-side timeout and in-flight dedupe in Home.svelte. Blocking duration is UNVERIFIED: needs a Windows run with a slow USB device.

The five app commands are not governed by any capability. With no AppManifest, Tauri skips the ACL check for local pages (verified at tauri 2.12.6 webview/mod.rs:2076-2084), so assess_file works as a file oracle for any path (FND-0030), and the capability file misleads readers (FND-0033). core:default also grants tray, menu, image and event commands the app never uses (FND-0032). Without the custom-protocol feature, cargo build --release loads devUrl, where those unguarded commands would be reachable from whatever serves 127.0.0.1:1420 (FND-0160). Fix: an AppManifest in build.rs, per-command permissions, a trimmed default capability and the custom-protocol feature. Security boundary, so decision D9.

ClamAV distribution. The engine is looked up next to the exe, so tauri dev reports it missing (FND-0004). The current_exe error is discarded (FND-0015). ADR 0002 promises the installer bundles clamscan and freshclam, but tauri.conf.json bundles nothing and the reason text differs (FND-0016). The binary is trusted on existence alone (FND-0051), and the package declares no license even though GPL-2.0 ClamAV ships with it (FND-0161). All of these follow from one distribution decision (D7). The ADR side goes to docs-reconciler after the decision.

Literal colours and sizes instead of tokens: in App (FND-0023), #ff009d copies of the VPN accent (FND-0085), and a separate GitHub-style palette with off-scale radii (FND-0086). The literal close-hover colour equals the VPN background, so the close button vanishes on hover (FND-0118). One pattern fix: route all of them through tokens.ts and CSS variables. All info severity, so human review. FND-0118 also needs a design choice for the close-hover colour.

Home.test false greens. You can delete the setInterval or the pending reset and all seven tests still pass (FND-0170). The cause is synchronous advanceTimersByTime with a magic five-microtask flush (FND-0175). The after-unmount test cannot fail (FND-0171). Fix: advanceTimersByTimeAsync, an assertion that polling resumes, a guard test that fails when the active flag is removed, and a console.error spy restored in afterEach. Shares the flush pattern with FND-0185 in U13; use one helper. Human review only because FND-0175 is info.

VirusesPage.test coverage. The required Журнал subsection is never rendered (FND-0180). No error path runs (FND-0181). The engine-missing reason and hint are not asserted (FND-0182). Re-entry and empty-target guards are untested (FND-0183), as are empty and disagreeing states (FND-0186). The fixed five-microtask flush is brittle (FND-0185). Tests only, one file, no info findings: auto-fix eligible. Constraints: if a new test exposes missing production behaviour (no re-entry guard, mismatch display), mark it as an expected failure that references U05 or U02 and do not change VirusesPage.svelte. Skip the duplicate-path case; it belongs to deferred FND-0092.

Cargo manifest hygiene. No rust-version or toolchain file (FND-0155). No [workspace.dependencies], so serde and path dependencies are declared inconsistently (FND-0156). No [workspace.lints], so -D warnings holds only from CLI flags (FND-0157). No release profile (FND-0158). sysinfo has unused default features (FND-0159). A redundant [[bin]] and empty features arrays (FND-0162). One consolidation pass. MSRV value and profile settings are decision D16.

PlaceholderPage has no accessible name, heading or live region, so screen-reader users cannot tell placeholder subsections apart (FND-0121). An empty note renders an empty dashed box (FND-0124). There is no test file and the note path is untested (FND-0125). Do this after D3 (U07) settles the placeholder wording.

Frontend error normalisation. An unknown backend kind becomes kind probe with message '[object Object]' (FND-0057, FND-0090). Non-CommandError rejections are labelled probe, though types.ts claims the message is already Russian (FND-0058). String(err) can throw (FND-0059). Tests cover one of four kinds and almost no rejection branches (FND-0192, FND-0194). Fix toCommandError (keep the message and allow an 'unknown' kind), then add the tests. The Rust error side is U58.

formatBytes shows 1024.0 of the smaller unit just under a boundary (FND-0073). There is no guard for non-finite or negative input (FND-0074). Values from 1 PiB up show as 1024+ ТБ (FND-0075). Fractions print raw floats (FND-0199). The tests pin none of the boundaries, the cap or the rounding mode (FND-0078, which absorbs FND-0197 and FND-0198). Write the boundary tests first (TDD), then fix the rounding carry and the input guard. The locale questions are U62, kept separate.

Contrast maths and its oracle. luminance never checks the hex format, so #fff reads as #000fff (FND-0082). textOn cannot reach 4.5:1 inside a narrow luminance band (FND-0083) and hard-codes #080808 and #ffffff (FND-0084). Tests pin contrastRatio only at 21:1, so a wrong exponent passes (FND-0204, which absorbs FND-0087). The purple-colour test checks another colour and hard-codes black (FND-0205). There are no neutral-pair or 3:1 UI tests (FND-0206, the regression guard for U06 FND-0019). Pin known WCAG reference values first, then validate input and use the tokens.

The app has two definitions of Downloads, and both are fragile. default_scan_target swallows a missing USERPROFILE and ignores a relocated Downloads folder (FND-0028). files.rs builds '\\Downloads' from an empty USERPROFILE (FND-0045). The heuristic flags in-startup and in-downloads for any folder with that name (FND-0044). One fix: a single known-folder resolver (SHGetKnownFolderPath for Downloads and Startup) used by both the default target and the heuristic.

CSP correctness and hardening: add connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost so release builds use the fast IPC path (FND-0034), and add base-uri 'none', form-action 'none' and freezePrototype (FND-0036). Small edits, but tauri.conf.json is a sensitive path. Keep the img-src data: question (FND-0035) out of this unit; it depends on D2 (U21).

The decorative 7% data: SVG pattern on .shell is blocked by CSP in release (FND-0035), so dev and release look different. In dev, where it renders, placeholder, lead and footer text over it falls to about 4.27:1, below AA (FND-0122). There are two exclusive fixes: keep the pattern (img-src data: plus a text backdrop or a lower pattern alpha) or drop it for flat colour. Owner decision D2.

The ЗВУК toggle changes its label and does nothing else, and it is enabled. CLAUDE.md requires unavailable features to be shown disabled with a reason, so the default fix is to disable it with a visible reason. If the owner wants sound implemented instead (D12), that becomes a new feature with its own plan. Auto-fix eligible for the disable-with-reason fix only.

--font-body is defined on .shell, a descendant of body, so body never receives it and BODY_FONT has no effect. Move the variable to :root or apply font-family on .shell. Trivial and local, so auto-fix eligible. U51 FND-0209 (font tests skip Segoe UI) is the matching test gap.

Home render branches with no test: the probe error heading, error clearing, the empty disk list, the usage line and the progressbar values (FND-0172). Two test names promise more than they check: mount point (FND-0173) and loading until data arrives (FND-0174). Do this after U12 so the async helper exists.

Window-control click counts are asserted only after all three clicks, so wiring minimise to close passes (FND-0176). Nothing checks the data-tauri-drag-region attributes, the only way to move the frameless window (FND-0177). Fix: assert after each click and assert the drag-region attributes. Tests only, one file, low/high: auto-fix eligible.

CLAUDE.md promises selecting findings and deleting them through quarantine. The code has no selection, Удалить is hard-disabled (FND-0099), and the test locks in that placeholder (FND-0184). This is a feature-scope gap (quarantine backend, confirmation flow), not a bug fix. Owner decision D8: build quarantine now or record it as planned and keep the disabled button with a reason.

VpnPage.test never calls cleanup, so DOM leaks between tests and results depend on order (FND-0189). It claims controls are disabled but never checks the security-relevant subscription input, and the routes branch is untested (FND-0131). Neither test checks that the other branch is absent (FND-0190). The fix is all in VpnPage.test.ts, even though FND-0131 names the component.

Invoke assertions use toHaveBeenCalledWith without call counts, so duplicate invokes go unseen (FND-0193). POLL_INTERVAL_MS is never asserted (FND-0195). Small test tightening. Coordinate with U01 and U16, which edit the same file.

TypeScript 6 vs 7 peer split. npm run check type-checks with an undeclared TypeScript 6.0.3 (the svelte-check peer), not the declared ^7.0.2 (FND-0146). @types/node ^26 vs the README's 'Node 22+' (FND-0154), and there is no engines field even though jsdom, vitest and vite need narrower Node ranges (FND-0151). One program mixes Node and DOM globals (FND-0145). isolatedModules is redundant with verbatimModuleSyntax (FND-0147, verified on TS 6.0.3). Decision D4 (which TypeScript major and which Node baseline) unblocks the whole unit. Then split tsconfig into node and app projects.

Scan target validation. validate_target accepts any UNC path (FND-0007) and, through the forward-slash branch, drive-relative, bare '/' and '//host' paths (FND-0052). Format and separator characters such as RLO pass the 'no control characters' check and get echoed to the UI (FND-0054). Paths are not canonicalised (FND-0027). scan() trusts its caller and passes no '--' end-of-options marker (FND-0049). Order: settle the policy (D10: are network targets allowed at all), tighten validate_target, canonicalise in commands.rs, add '--' in clamav.rs. Do it after U02 so the scan.rs edits do not collide.

Engine availability is read once at startup (FND-0002) and fetched once at mount, with no retry. An IPC failure leaves the start button disabled forever, and after installing ClamAV the user has to switch sections (FND-0095). Fix: compute status on request (or add a refresh command), then add a Обновить control and error state in VirusesPage. Coordinate with U10 (engine location).

App routing false greens. The navigation tests check only the h1 and the subtab buttons, never the page that renders, so App.svelte:65-75 can be deleted with every test green (FND-0163). Computer routing is untested (FND-0129). That is also why the getSystemOverview mock is dead (FND-0166). The section-switch reset of activeSub is untested (FND-0164). All fixes are in App.test.ts.

The disabled VPN input has no attached reason, the button reason lives only in title, and the visible note is not linked by aria-describedby (FND-0132). The input name comes only from an aria-label that differs from the visible heading (FND-0134). The title promises import 'в следующей версии' with no documented basis (FND-0133, decision D14).

A duplicate subsection id makes the keyed each in Subtabs throw each_key_duplicate, so the section page does not render (FND-0112). The sections test checks uniqueness of section ids only, not subsection ids (FND-0081). Add a per-section uniqueness test. The U03 type work can make duplicates a compile-time error.

Weak typing in config and declaration files. A wildcard *.svelte module type erases prop types for plain tsc and some editors (FND-0088). vite/client is referenced twice (FND-0089). svelte.config.js has no SvelteConfig JSDoc type (FND-0143). Low-risk tidy-up. Do it after U29 settles the TypeScript version.

Suspicion heuristic quality. It misses common disguises and startup file types (FND-0008). A substring crack-word match scores benign names (FND-0010). A trailing dot or space zeroes the score (FND-0053, Win32 normalisation UNVERIFIED). Tests are weak or missing in both files (FND-0046, FND-0056). The heuristic only hints, but its list of extensions and startup types is a product choice (D22). Do it after U02 and U30, which edit scan.rs first.

Disk identity. The display name is checked trimmed but stored untrimmed, and zero-width names count as non-empty (FND-0069). Home keys disks by mountPoint, and lossy UTF-16 conversion can map two mount points to the same string, which throws each_key_duplicate with no boundary (FND-0104). Fix: a stable unique disk key from the backend, or index-qualified keys, plus name normalisation. Whether duplicates can occur on real Windows is UNVERIFIED.

Windows overview correctness. Real probe failures come back as zeros, so the UI shows fabricated 0% readings and the Probe error path never triggers (FND-0038). The ok_or_else branch is unreachable (FND-0042). Network, optical and RAM drives are omitted, and a volume with several mount paths is counted once per path (FND-0041, scope is decision D21). Sensitive path. Coordinate with U08, which edits the same file.

VERSION in App.svelte is a hand-kept copy of the package.json and tauri.conf.json versions. Inject it at build time (Vite define from package.json) or read it with the Tauri app API. Which file is the single source is decision D19.

Placeholder.svelte is an orphan duplicate of PlaceholderPage.svelte: no importer, not bundled, no tests (FND-0127). It would add a second h1 if used (FND-0126). The skeleton plan still says to create it, and its checkbox is unchecked (FND-0128, out-of-scope doc). Deleting a source file and editing the plan is an owner call (D11). Deletion here is of repo source, not user files, so the quarantine rule does not apply.

TitleBar robustness. getCurrentWindow() at component start throws outside Tauri, so App cannot mount in a plain browser (FND-0115). Window-control promises are dropped, so a rejection gives no feedback (FND-0116). The maximise label and glyph never track the maximised state (FND-0117). The test mocks return undefined instead of promises, so the rejection path cannot be tested and a .catch would throw (FND-0178). Fix the mocks first, then the component.

resolve.conditions ['browser'] applies to dev, build and tests, and it replaces Vite's defaults, so the development and production conditions drop and Svelte dev checks may be lost in tauri dev (FND-0136). The comment says it is test-only (FND-0139). Fix: scope it to test (vitest resolve or a mode check) and correct the comment. Whether define rewriting masks this is UNVERIFIED.

VPN-first vs Вирусы-first. CLAUDE.md contradicts itself: the section list says VPN opens first, and the antivirus section calls Вирусы first in navigation. The code opens VPN (FND-0022). The union comment in sections.ts claims panel order but lists viruses before vpn (FND-0080). Code alone cannot settle this: decision D1, then docs-reconciler updates CLAUDE.md and the comment, and code changes only if the owner picks Вирусы.

build.rs hygiene. Bare build() misses rerun triggers for later manifests and env vars (FND-0061, FND-0062). The RC tool resolves from PATH and panics through unwrap (FND-0063; CLAUDE.md wants absolute tool paths, though here it is upstream tauri-build behaviour). gen/schemas is written into the source tree (FND-0064). The default Windows manifest has no requestedExecutionLevel or supportedOS (FND-0065), which relates to the 'admin per action' rule (decision D15). Coordinate with U09, which adds an AppManifest to the same file.

A startup failure in a release build is invisible: .expect panics under the GUI subsystem with no console. Fix: catch the run error and show a native message box (windows-sys MessageBoxW behind cfg(windows)), or write a local log file (no telemetry). Auto-fix eligible on the condition that it adds no Tauri plugin or capability. If it needs one, escalate to human review.

At the 600px minimum height the rail, controls and title bar total about 733px, so the page scrolls and the frameless title bar leaves the screen (FND-0107). Fix: make the rail scroll internally or compress it. The main nav is nested inside an aside landmark (FND-0108); fix the landmark structure. Local, low severity, no info: auto-fix eligible. Verify the height on a real 600px Windows window.

VirusesPage local defects. The journal key (startedAt HH:MM:SS plus target) collides for runs in the same second or at the same clock time on different days (FND-0093): use a monotonic id. assessFile errors are swallowed by .catch(() => null) (FND-0094): show the reason. Disabled buttons carry their reason only in title, and the start button has none (FND-0097): add a visible reason. One file, no info findings: auto-fix eligible. Run it after U05 if that unit is scheduled, because both edit this file.

The TAURI_DEV_HOST branch is mobile-template code with no in-scope caller. A non-loopback host breaks the hardcoded 127.0.0.1 devUrl (FND-0137). With a LAN or 0.0.0.0 host, ports 1420/1421 expose the sources (FND-0138). server.hmr.* is deprecated in Vite 8 (FND-0140). Simplest fix: drop the branch and bind loopback only, which is decision D23 (mobile is not a target).

The rail aria-label repeats the visible title and can drift from it (FND-0110). No test checks aria-current or the active class (FND-0111). Remove the redundant label and add the assertion. Do it with or after U46.

TitleBar polish. The 8px gaps between buttons are not drag regions (FND-0119). The glyph buttons have no tooltip, and Segoe UI may fall back for ▢ and ✕ (FND-0120, partly UNVERIFIED). The tests use redundant toBeTruthy after getByText (FND-0179). All info.

Token tests restate literals instead of checking rules. sections.test duplicates the tokens accent format check (FND-0203). The NEUTRAL, RADIUS and TYPE_SCALE tests repeat values with no rules (FND-0208). A test claims to match brief.md, which has no hex values (FND-0207, doc-drift). The font tests skip Segoe UI (FND-0209). Replace them with rule checks (monotonic scale, valid formats, Segoe UI first on Windows). Coordinate with U18 on tokens.test.ts.

The sweep animation check confirms only that the element exists; CSS cannot be verified under jsdom (FND-0187), so record that limitation and assert class:active and the progress text. Fixtures use what looks like a real username in paths (FND-0188); replace it with a neutral placeholder, which is a privacy improvement. Run with U13 on the same file.
The entry point and its missing-#app guard have no test. Add a small vitest that mounts with and without #app.

ADR 0001 lists only SystemInfoPort, but the core also exposes VirusScanPort, and the plan promises a ScanRequest DTO that does not exist. Docs-only reconciliation (docs/ is out of audit scope). Update it when U01 changes the ADR's DTO claim.

One transient error hides the last good overview behind an alert (FND-0105). Polling continues every 2 s after an Unsupported error that cannot change (FND-0106). Fix: keep the stale data with an inline warning, and stop polling (or back off) on unsupported. Coordinate with U08, which edits the same file.
The journal records only successful scans. Failed attempts (invalid target, missing engine, clamscan error) are not listed. Whether the journal should show failures is decision D20.

system.rs DTO hygiene. usage_percent converts u64 to f32 before dividing (FND-0066): divide in f64. DTO fields and helpers are pub, so other crates can bypass clamping, and NaN serialises as null (FND-0067). The tests miss infinities, -0.0, several JSON keys and Display variants (FND-0068).

Backend error taxonomy. A JoinError from a panic is reported as kind probe with untranslated tokio text, though the doc says the message is Russian (FND-0029). The 'ошибка чтения системных данных' prefix is reused for scan failures, and CoreError holds scan variants in the system module (FND-0070). The command wrappers and the JoinError mapping have no tests (FND-0031). Pairs with U16 on the TS side (decision D24).

Subtabs are view switchers marked up as a nav landmark with aria-current, with the same 'Подразделы' label in every section (FND-0114). They should be a tablist with tabs, aria-selected and aria-controls. No test clicks a subtab or checks the selection (FND-0113). Change the semantics and the tests together.

svelte.config.js clarity. vitePreprocess does not preprocess TypeScript in v7, so the config looks like TS support but is not (FND-0141, doc-drift).
